title: Cyrus and the Escarpment
author: Dominic Ravensworth
blurb: Emrys Yarrow, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
